tiers.measured: A quantity someone measured, or a definition. The number is checkable; the octave shift is arithmetic.
tiers.protocol: A procedure with a rationale — how to move through frequencies, not a claim about any single one.
tiers.lore: Beautiful, old, and unproven. The arithmetic is real; the meaning is poetry. Kept, and labelled.

entries.name: Delta
entries.note: 0.5–4 Hz. Dominant in deep sleep. Slow enough that you feel it as pulsing rather than pitch.

entries.name: Theta
entries.note: 4–8 Hz. Drowsiness, light meditation, inward attention. Raised resting theta is the most replicated EEG finding in ADHD, which is why focus sessions here avoid it.
entries.source: EEG band convention · theta/beta ratio literature

entries.name: Alpha
entries.note: 8–12 Hz. The idle rhythm of relaxed alertness — it rises when you close your eyes.

entries.name: SMR
entries.note: 12–15 Hz sensorimotor rhythm: still body, alert mind. The band ADHD neurofeedback protocols try to raise. Folds to 216 Hz — an octave below the 432 the lore tier is fond of, which is a coincidence and nothing more.

entries.name: Beta
entries.note: 15–30 Hz. Active thinking, judgement, single-task effort. The working band of every focus arc here.

entries.name: Gamma 40
entries.note: The frequency the MIT sensory-entrainment work is built on. Studied for dementia, not for ADHD — but 40 Hz binaural beats have also narrowed attentional focus in lab tasks.
entries.source: Iaccarino et al. 2016; Colzato et al. 2017

entries.name: Schumann resonance
entries.note: The fundamental standing wave in the cavity between the Earth's surface and the ionosphere, excited by lightning. Genuinely measured, genuinely 7.83 Hz, and it happens to sit in theta.

entries.name: Schumann II
entries.note: The second mode of the same cavity. Lands inside SMR.

entries.name: Earth day
entries.note: One rotation, raised twenty-four octaves. The period is a fact; hearing it is arithmetic.
entries.source: SI day · Cousto's cosmic octave method

entries.name: Earth year
entries.note: One tropical orbit, raised thirty-two octaves. The 136.10 Hz result is the tone Cousto matched to a tuning fork and called OM.

entries.name: The second
entries.note: The caesium-133 hyperfine transition. Since 1967 this number does not measure the second — it defines it. Lowered twenty-six octaves, it is a listenable tone.

entries.name: Hydrogen line
entries.note: The 21 cm spin-flip of neutral hydrogen — the most abundant note in the universe, and the channel radio astronomy listens on.

entries.name: Cosmic microwave background
entries.note: The spectral peak of the oldest light there is, 2.725 K of blackbody radiation. Lowered thirty octaves it becomes a mid-range hum.

entries.name: Resting heartbeat
entries.note: Sixty beats a minute is exactly one hertz, and one hertz raised seven octaves is 128 Hz. The body already keeps time in this system.

entries.name: A = 440
entries.note: Concert pitch by international agreement (ISO 16). A convention, not a discovery — which is exactly what the 432 believers get right and then over-read.

entries.name: Onset dose
entries.note: Start the sound before the work, not with it. In the 2019 meta-analysis, exposure before and during a task beat exposure during it alone. Every arc in this app opens with a ramp for that reason.

stages.label: onset
stages.why: climb from alpha into SMR before the task begins

entries.name: SMR up-train
entries.note: A slow sweep across the sensorimotor band, in the direction ADHD neurofeedback rewards. Neurofeedback trains your own rhythm; a beat only offers one. Not the same thing, and the difference matters.

entries.name: Anxiolytic descent
entries.note: Alpha down into theta and delta, where the meta-analysis found its largest effect (g ≈ 0.69, for anxiety). The clearest thing binaural beats have been shown to do is help people feel calmer.

stages.label: alpha
stages.why: meet the state you are in

entries.name: Pomodoro
entries.note: Twenty-five minutes of work, then stop. The protocol is the timer, not the tone; the sound just marks the shape so the ending arrives as a change in the room.

stages.label: stop
stages.why: an audible edge to stop at

entries.name: Coherent breathing
entries.note: Six breaths a minute — 0.1 Hz — is the rate that maximises heart-rate variability, a well-replicated result. Here it drives an amplitude swell you can breathe with, not a beat you could hear.

stages.label: breathe
stages.why: the tone swells and fades at six cycles a minute — follow it

entries.name: Focus 10
entries.note: Hemi-Sync's first named level: "mind awake, body asleep". Carrier around 100 Hz, a delta-to-theta beat, pink noise over the top. The 1983 CIA assessment of the Gateway Process describes the mechanism as hemispheric synchronisation via the frequency-following response.

stages.label: focus 10
stages.why: delta beat, body asleep, mind awake

entries.name: Focus 12
entries.note: The next rung: "expanded awareness". Wider stereo, brighter carrier, theta beat.

entries.name: Focus 15
entries.note: "No time." A long flat theta/delta plateau with nothing to mark the minutes.

stages.label: focus 15
stages.why: flat plateau — no cues, no clock

entries.name: GENUS 40 Hz
entries.note: Gamma ENtrainment Using Sensory Stimulation: 40 Hz clicks, an hour a day, from the MIT work on Alzheimer's models and the human trials that followed. Isochronic here, because the trials used pulses, not binaural illusions. Nothing to do with ADHD — kept because it is the strongest evidence that sound at a frequency changes a brain at all.
entries.source: Iaccarino et al. 2016; Martorell et al. 2019; Cognito phase II

stages.label: 40 Hz
stages.why: pulsed at 40 Hz, as in the trials

entries.name: Mercury
entries.note: 87.97 days, raised thirty octaves. Cousto's cosmic octave: real orbital mechanics, then a leap to meaning that nothing supports.

entries.name: Venus
entries.note: 224.70 days, thirty-two octaves up.

entries.name: Mars
entries.note: 686.98 days, thirty-three octaves up.

entries.name: Jupiter
entries.note: 11.86 years, thirty-six octaves up.

entries.name: Saturn
entries.note: 29.45 years, thirty-seven octaves up.

entries.name: Moon
entries.note: The synodic month, 29.53 days — new moon to new moon. Twenty-nine octaves up.

entries.name: Platonic year
entries.note: 25,920 years: one full precession of the equinoxes, forty-seven octaves up. The longest number in the catalogue.

entries.name: A = 432
entries.note: A rival concert pitch with a devoted following and no evidence of any special effect. It is a nice number — 432 = 2⁴·3³ — and that is the whole case.

entries.name: Solfeggio 174
entries.note: The lowest of the nine. The set was assembled in the 1970s from a numerological reading of a Latin hymn; it is not medieval, and no clinical claim survives contact with a control group.

entries.name: Solfeggio 396
entries.note: "Liberation from fear", per the tradition. A pleasant low tone, and the digits sum to 9, like every number in the set — which is the actual pattern.

entries.name: Solfeggio 528
entries.note: The famous one, sold as the "DNA repair" frequency. There is no such mechanism. It is still a good C-ish tone to build a drone on.

entries.name: Solfeggio 639
entries.note: Digits sum to 9. Everything in this family does.

entries.name: Solfeggio 963
entries.note: The top of the set, folded down an octave to sit in range.

entries.name: Pi
entries.note: π scaled by a hundred: 314.16 Hz. A pure numeral with no dimensions, so calling it a frequency is a choice, not a measurement.

entries.name: Golden angle
entries.note: 360°/φ² — the angle sunflower seeds actually use. Read as hertz it is 137.51 Hz, which is degrees pretending to be a frequency.

entries.name: Euler's e
entries.note: e times a hundred: 271.83 Hz. Same unit-free liberty as π.

entries.name: Speed of light
entries.note: The number is exact by definition. Treating metres per second as hertz is a unit error, not physics — which is precisely why it lives in this tier and not the first one.

entries.name: Fibonacci 233
entries.note: The thirteenth Fibonacci number. Its neighbours 144 and 377 make ratios near φ, so a stack built from them beats slowly and never quite repeats.
